attempts.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted file-backed volume on node1 mounted at /srv/secure, configured to auto-unlock (via a root-only keyfile referenced in /etc/crypttab) and auto-mount (via /etc/fstab) at boot with no manual intervention. Verified across a full node reboot: boot_id changed, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and the fstab mount both came up active automatically, and the test file written before reboot was readable afterward.
